%% cvforge-template v1
%% sections: experience, skills, education
%% supports: person.phone
%% max-bullets-per-role: 4
%
% Deliberately parser-hostile fixture: icon glyphs glued to text. Must fail the round-trip.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[a4paper,margin=2cm]{geometry}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{marvosym}
\input{glyphtounicode}
\pdfgentounicode=1
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\begin{document}
{\LARGE\bfseries \VAR{person.name}}\par
\Letter\,\VAR{person.email} \quad \Mobilefone\,\VAR{person.phone}\par
\BLOCK{for job in experience}
\textbf{\VAR{job.title}} \quad \Industry\,\VAR{job.org} \quad \Clocklogo\,\VAR{job.start} -- \VAR{job.end}\par
\begin{itemize}
\BLOCK{for b in job.bullets}
  \item \VAR{b.text} % id:\VAR{b.id}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\end{itemize}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\textbf{Skills}\par
\VAR{skills|join('\\,\\Pointinghand\\,')}\par
\BLOCK{for ed in education}
\textbf{\VAR{ed.degree}} \quad \VAR{ed.org} \quad \Clocklogo\,\VAR{ed.end}\par
\BLOCK{endfor}
\end{document}
